events.reply:
That request doesn't quite add up, so I want to check before doing anything.

You've said you're vegetarian and always have been, but chicken katsu is a breaded chicken cutlet. There's no "usual chicken katsu order" that would fit that. A few possibilities:

- You meant a vegetarian katsu (e.g., tofu katsu, sweet potato katsu, or a veggie katsu curry), which some places do offer.
- The order is for someone else and you want it added under their name.
- Something else entirely.

Also, for what it's worth, I don't currently have access to any team lunch signup document or a record of your "usual" order. If you can point me to the signup (a file, sheet, or link) and confirm exactly what should go in and under whose name, I'll take care of it.
